entries.original: `/btw <question>` creates *another* side instead of reusing the last one; starting BTW while viewing a side creates a sibling under the same main conversation.
entries.translated: `/btw <question>` creates *another* side instead of reusing the last one; starting BTW while viewing a side creates a sibling under the same main conversation.

entries.original: Bare `/btw` opens a picker with three sections: Main conversation, retained sides listed oldest-first as `BTW #1`, `BTW #2` with question summaries, and a New BTW action. The current destination is preselected, and the picker and long transcripts scroll with the mouse wheel.
entries.translated: Bare `/btw` opens a picker with three sections: Main conversation, retained sides listed oldest-first as `BTW #1`, `BTW #2` with question summaries, and a New BTW action. The current destination is preselected, and the picker and long transcripts scroll with the mouse wheel.

entries.original: **Key semantics changed, retrain your fingers:** `Esc Esc` returns to Main *without deleting* the side (closing BTW used to delete it), `Ctrl+C` from an empty composer deletes only the visible side, and `Ctrl+/` opens the picker from any related view, now also recognized on terminals that encode it as `Ctrl+7`.
entries.translated: **Key semantics changed, retrain your fingers:** `Esc Esc` returns to Main *without deleting* the side (closing BTW used to delete it), `Ctrl+C` from an empty composer deletes only the visible side, and `Ctrl+/` opens the picker from any related view, now also recognized on terminals that encode it as `Ctrl+7`.

entries.original: The 64-message / 64 KiB read-only context inheritance and the guarantee that side traffic never touches the main transcript are unchanged.
entries.translated: The 64-message / 64 KiB read-only context inheritance and the guarantee that side traffic never touches the main transcript are unchanged.

entries.original: **Revived nodes stay in the run (#7106).** A node you revive mid-flight is now tracked by the scheduler itself; a run can no longer declare itself finished while your revived node is still working, and it fails loudly if it ever could.
entries.translated: **Revived nodes stay in the run (#7106).** A node you revive mid-flight is now tracked by the scheduler itself; a run can no longer declare itself finished while your revived node is still working, and it fails loudly if it ever could.

entries.original: **Parent-side verification directive (#7080).** DAG completion payloads now tell the orchestrating parent to treat the claim as false until proven: read the artifacts, run the commands, and send corrective instructions back to the exact node until its own verification passes. Non-DAG completions are byte-identical.
entries.translated: **Parent-side verification directive (#7080).** DAG completion payloads now tell the orchestrating parent to treat the claim as false until proven: read the artifacts, run the commands, and send corrective instructions back to the exact node until its own verification passes. Non-DAG completions are byte-identical.

entries.original: **Real errors, surfaced (#7105).** The eval SDK used to swallow non-start DAG errors as successes and report a `definition_conflict` as "no run_id". Every response now routes through a choke point that rethrows the tool's own code and message.
entries.translated: **Real errors, surfaced (#7105).** The eval SDK used to swallow non-start DAG errors as successes and report a `definition_conflict` as "no run_id". Every response now routes through a choke point that rethrows the tool's own code and message.

entries.original: **Windows lock contention (#7107).** Filesystems that refuse hard links (`EPERM`/`EACCES` on NTFS ACLs, ReFS, network shares) no longer crash the losing racer; the lock falls back to an equally atomic exclusive open and the loser waits as designed.
entries.translated: **Windows lock contention (#7107).** Filesystems that refuse hard links (`EPERM`/`EACCES` on NTFS ACLs, ReFS, network shares) no longer crash the losing racer; the lock falls back to an equally atomic exclusive open and the loser waits as designed.

entries.original: **Your message paints instantly.** Enter now renders an optimistic pending bubble at once instead of waiting for the provider round-trip; the canonical message replaces it in place, and rejected or command-handled inputs remove it.
entries.translated: **Your message paints instantly.** Enter now renders an optimistic pending bubble at once instead of waiting for the provider round-trip; the canonical message replaces it in place, and rejected or command-handled inputs remove it.

entries.original: **The TUI stops pegging a core under provider-error storms.** Contended settings-lock waiters used to busy-spin on the main thread and freeze the render loop; they now sleep through `Atomics.wait`, fallback-chain canonicalization is memoized per error burst, and OAuth-lane settings loads are cached by mtime and size.
entries.translated: **The TUI stops pegging a core under provider-error storms.** Contended settings-lock waiters used to busy-spin on the main thread and freeze the render loop; they now sleep through `Atomics.wait`, fallback-chain canonicalization is memoized per error burst, and OAuth-lane settings loads are cached by mtime and size.

entries.original: **Settings reads are lock-free.** Writers publish atomically via temp file plus rename, so reads never join a lock convoy and never observe a torn write.
entries.translated: **Settings reads are lock-free.** Writers publish atomically via temp file plus rename, so reads never join a lock convoy and never observe a torn write.

entries.original: **Claude policy refusals fail immediately** on the `claude-sdk-oauth` lane with the real reason, instead of hanging ~90 seconds into the watchdog and re-billing the conversation on retry.
entries.translated: **Claude policy refusals fail immediately** on the `claude-sdk-oauth` lane with the real reason, instead of hanging ~90 seconds into the watchdog and re-billing the conversation on retry.

entries.original: **`monitor` prompting matches the real PTY contract**, with worked recipes so the agent waits the way the tool actually behaves.
entries.translated: **`monitor` prompting matches the real PTY contract**, with worked recipes so the agent waits the way the tool actually behaves.

entries.original: **Provider catalogs refreshed:** the vercel-ai-gateway Grok vendor slug moved `xai/` to `spacexai/`, and opencode delisted `deepseek-v4-flash-free`.
entries.translated: **Provider catalogs refreshed:** the vercel-ai-gateway Grok vendor slug moved `xai/` to `spacexai/`, and opencode delisted `deepseek-v4-flash-free`.

entries.original: **The auth store gets the same lock-spin fix**, so multi-session OAuth-refresh contention can no longer burn a core.
entries.translated: **The auth store gets the same lock-spin fix**, so multi-session OAuth-refresh contention can no longer burn a core.

entries.original: **The model picker releases before the auth round trip.** Choosing a subscription-OAuth model like Cursor no longer freezes a frame of the previous model on screen while the network call resolves.
entries.translated: **The model picker releases before the auth round trip.** Choosing a subscription-OAuth model like Cursor no longer freezes a frame of the previous model on screen while the network call resolves.

entries.original: **Cursor turns end when the server says they ended.** A decoded `turnEnded` is definitive completion with a 5s drain, and silent streams fail in 30s (90s if heartbeat-only) instead of sitting out the 5-minute idle timeout.
entries.translated: **Cursor turns end when the server says they ended.** A decoded `turnEnded` is definitive completion with a 5s drain, and silent streams fail in 30s (90s if heartbeat-only) instead of sitting out the 5-minute idle timeout.

entries.original: **JavaScript eval cells accept `local://`** paths like every other kernel.
entries.translated: **JavaScript eval cells accept `local://`** paths like every other kernel.

entries.original: **mass-ULW answers to more names (#7076):** `ulw mass`, `ulwmass`, `mulw`, and `meth` now trigger it alongside the existing spellings; the guard that keeps `ulw-plan` from matching is intact.
entries.translated: **mass-ULW answers to more names (#7076):** `ulw mass`, `ulwmass`, `mulw`, and `meth` now trigger it alongside the existing spellings; the guard that keeps `ulw-plan` from matching is intact.

entries.original: **Background completion notifications reach the right project (#7077):** the live server route now carries its registered directory into the SDK client instead of defaulting to the server's.
entries.translated: **Background completion notifications reach the right project (#7077):** the live server route now carries its registered directory into the SDK client instead of defaulting to the server's.

entries.original: **The ultrawork build fails loudly on stale tokens (#7081):** `wait_for` joined the forbidden-token list, so a directive can never again tell the model to call a tool that does not exist. #7085 briefly dropped the goal-registration mandate and #7088 restored it verbatim, netting to no change in the shipped directive.

entries.original: **Docs caught up with the code (#7093):** a 22-file sweep corrects `config migrate`, documents the `update` command, fixes `boulder` and `--codex-autonomous` claims, and describes the telemetry identifier and cleanup scope accurately.
